title: Put a clog on a seated toddler manikin's dangling foot: knee bent back, toes under the vamp, heel in front of the strap
instruction: Put the clog on the manikin's bare right foot, with the clog's heel strap behind the heel, then let go of the clog and the leg.
context: Putting a shoe on a small child who sits with feet dangling is an everyday chore for parents, grandparents and babysitters, and for childcare workers (O*NET 39-9011.00, 1,010,300 employed in 2025; task statement: "Dress children and change diapers."). Anyone can tell at a glance whether the shoe went on properly. A clog's heel strap closes the back of the shoe into a ring: the foot cannot be slid in from behind or from the front. It has to go in from above, toes first and pointing down, the heel coming down in front of the strap. A seated child's dangling foot points down only while the knee is held bent back, so one hand works the leg while the other brings the clog.
setup: Cm from the midpoint between the arm bases, x away from the robot, y left; heights above the table, which stands in for the floor. Child's wooden chair, fixed: seat 23 x 34 x 1.5 cm, top 26.4 up, front edge at x 51, centred on y -7; back 26 tall; four 3 cm square legs. Toddler manikin: a full-size jointed doll, either built for about $40 (estimate) from the README's parts list and drawing (leg.svg: a seat board, two fixed thigh tubes, a trunk block, and lower legs of dowel, foam sleeve and a shaped foot block, the right one on a knee pin), or a one-year-old pediatric care simulator with jointed knees (Gaumard S110 "Mike and Michelle", 32 in, 81 cm), seated at the front of the seat facing the robot, trunk fixed to the chair back, hands in its lap: thighs level, knees at x 40 and 30 up, 14 apart (right knee y 0, left y -14). Each lower leg hangs from its knee: knee to ankle 19, ankle to sole 3.5, foot 13 long and 5.4 wide, heel 3.2 behind the shank, toes toward the robot, soles 7.5 above the floor. The right lower leg (350 g) swings freely on its knee hinge (115 degrees back, 8 forward); its ankle is held rigid at a right angle (taped if the manikin's ankle is jointed). The built doll is made to these sizes; for the simulator they are estimates for a manikin of that length, not measurements of that model. The left lower leg is fixed and wears a clog. Two blue foam clogs, toddler size 6, 45 g each: 15.8 long, 7.2 wide, sole 1.5 thick; inside 14.8 long, 6.2 wide; closed vamp over the front 7, 3 high inside at the toes rising to 5.8 at its back edge; open behind it, side walls 2.2 falling to a 1.4 heel rim. Heel strap: a U of 7 mm round foam, 4 g, on rivets 9 back from the inside toe end and 2.4 above the footbed, its crossbar 6.2 from the rivets; it turns against light friction. Start: the loose clog stands on the floor in front of the right foot, toes toward the robot, its inside toe end at x 10.5, y 0 (layout B: x 12.5, y -4.5), strap back with its crossbar lying on the heel rim.
scoring: Scored at the end, measured in the clog with a ruler: lengths back from the inside of its toe end, heights from its footbed. 0 unless the toes are under the vamp: the tip of the toes within 4.5 cm of the inside toe end (the heel's back then sticks out no more than 2.2 cm behind the heel rim), within 2 cm of the clog's midline, and between 1 cm below and 3.5 cm above the footbed's level. Then 0.25. 0.5 if also the clog hangs on the foot: at least 5 mm clear of the floor, at rest (under 2 cm/s, the leg turning under 0.2 rad/s: nothing visibly moving) and both grippers at least 3 cm from clog and leg. 0.75 instead if the leg comes up through the opening in front of the strap but the clog is still held, moving or on the floor: the shank's middle, at the height of the strap's rivets, lies between 5 mm in front of the vamp's back edge and the front of the strap's crossbar, within 2.5 cm of the midline; the heel's back is in front of the crossbar; the ankle's middle is no more than 7.5 cm above the footbed. 1.0: through the opening in front of the strap, and hanging on the foot, let go and at rest.
reset_notes: Take the clog off the foot, swing its strap back onto the heel rim and stand the clog on its mark. Let the right leg hang until it is still.
fidelity: Rigid convex pieces at full size. The foot does not flex at the toes and the foam does not give, so the clog is cut roomy (1.8 cm longer and 8 mm wider inside than the foot) and its strap clears the heel by 1.4 cm instead of hugging it. Masses, the knee's friction (0.03 N m) and the strap rivets' friction (0.012 N m) are estimates, not measurements. The manikin's ankle is rigid and its trunk fixed. Foam meets a gripper pad over a 6 mm patch.
